title: Numeric object id can be walked to another user's record (needs two accounts)
summary: A numeric id in a route can be changed to read a record that belongs to someone else.  Proving this needs a second test account, so it only runs once two accounts are configured.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: As account A, request account B's object id over the same route.
remediate: Check the object's owner against the signed in user on every read.
